app.name: Git Quick Ref
app.subject: Git version control
app.description: Commands and processes for everyday Git work.

nodes.title: Start a repository
nodes.highlight:
git init
git clone <url>
git config --global user.name "Name"
git config --global user.email "you@example.com"
steps: New project: git init in its folder.
Set name and email once per machine.

nodes.title: Save work
nodes.highlight:
git status
git add <file>    (-A = all)
git commit -m "message"
git log --oneline
steps: Commit with a message that says why.
nodes.caution: Commit small, related changes. One idea per commit.

nodes.title: Branches
nodes.highlight:
git switch -c <name>    new + switch
git switch <name>       switch
git merge <name>        into current
git branch -d <name>    delete merged
steps: Switch to the target branch, then merge.

nodes.title: Merge conflict
steps: Open each file git status lists as conflicted.
Keep the right lines between <<<<<<< and >>>>>>>, delete the markers.
git add <file> for each, then git commit.
nodes.caution: git merge --abort returns to before the merge.

nodes.title: Sync with a remote
nodes.highlight:
git remote -v
git fetch
git pull
git push -u origin <branch>
nodes.body: fetch downloads without changing your files; pull = fetch + merge.
nodes.caution: Pull before you push to avoid a rejected push.

nodes.title: Unstage a file
nodes.body: The edits stay in the file; only the staging is undone.

nodes.title: Discard edits
nodes.caution: Uncommitted edits are lost for good.

nodes.title: Fix the last commit
nodes.body: Stage forgotten files first; they join the last commit.
nodes.caution: Only before pushing: amending rewrites history.

nodes.title: Undo a pushed commit
nodes.body: Makes a new commit that reverses the old one. Safe on shared branches.

nodes.title: Habits
nodes.body:
Run git status before and after anything.
Never commit secrets; list them in .gitignore.
Don't rewrite history others have pulled.

nodes.title: Reading history
nodes.highlight:
git log --oneline --graph
git show <sha>
git diff            unstaged
git diff --staged   staged
